kultivator.formasi.spec.alarm_restrictio: Warns the sect when intruders come near (radius to radius + 8) and when they break in (inside the radius): action-bar line, bell at the eye, HUD arrow and chat line with direction and distance. LAN strangers are reported too. Elites and bosses also raise a title.
Bell on the eye; four pillars of chiseled stone bricks topped with copper lanterns, 3 blocks out on each side. Works as a personal formation too.

Desolate Era Book 8 ch. 30 "Hunted": an alarm formation hidden in a mountain gives off no elemental ripples and warns its makers when anyone enters. RMJ ch. 399: sound transmission talismans knock against the restrictions of Han Li's cave residence. The bell and the stranger rule are game design.
kultivator.formasi.spec.concealment_rest: Hostile mobs outside the radius cannot pick a new target among the members, disciples, pets and spirit beasts inside, unless that target hurt them in the last 3 s. Outside mobs already hunting someone inside lose them. Mobs already inside are not affected. Elites see through a Yellow formation; bosses always see.
Tinted glass under the eye; moss blocks with azalea leaves on top 3 blocks out on each side; dark stone (dark prismarine, deepslate tiles or polished deepslate) on the four corners.

RMJ ch. 520: Han Li places another concealment restriction in the refining room of his new cave residence before a closed-door refinement. RMJ ch. 803: the restriction outside his cave residence was not top grade, so many cultivators discovered it.
kultivator.formasi.spec.concealment_dete: The concealment rules over the whole territory (counts as Mystic, so tier-1 elites are fooled too), plus the alarm over the whole territory: intruders in the 16 blocks outside the edge are reported by direction and LAN strangers are named.
Tinted glass under the eye and a soul lantern on it; four pillars of dark stone, tinted glass and a copper lantern 5 blocks out; moss with azalea leaves on the diagonals at 4.

RMJ ch. 995: Han Li tosses formation flags and plates into the air, multicoloured light fills the cavern, and a simple spell formation gives concealment and detection, warning him early if anybody trespasses. RMJ ch. 803: the grade of a restriction matters.
kultivator.formasi.spec.five_elements_re: A maze: intruders inside cannot take new targets deep in the field and are led around the ring, slowed; every 60 s the pattern shifts and the circulation reverses. After 20 s inside a mob is pushed out once. Elites are not slowed and are steered less often.

Faces true north. Raw gold block under the eye (Earth). Element pillars 5 out, body ×2 plus a light on top: Wood (bamboo) east, Fire south, Metal (iron) west, Water north. Chiseled tuff bricks on the corners at 3.

RMJ ch. 231 "Disaster Knocking on the Door": flags are inserted and plates buried, small spirit-stone formations supply it, and the master flag ceaselessly shifts the patterns to trap enemies. RMJ ch. 363: only inside his Five Elements Reversal Formation does Han Li breathe a sigh of relief.
kultivator.formasi.spec.nine_bend_yellow: A great maze with no straight path: intruders are led in bends between the inner and outer ring, slowed (II), and every pulse strips Strength, Speed, Resistance, Fire Resistance, Invisibility, Regeneration and Absorption; elite skills are silenced inside and for 3 s after. After 30 s a mob is pushed out once. Bosses are stripped but never steered.

A cauldron on the eye (the Hunyuan Golden Dipper), a gold block under it; eight posts of calcite ×2 with a banner on top, 9 out on the cardinals and 6 out on the diagonals. Five-coloured banners recommended.

Investiture of the Gods ch. 50: the plan is drawn in white earth with five-coloured banners; "in its nine bends there is no straight path"; immortals who enter become mortals, their three flowers removed. The Hunyuan Golden Dipper captures.
kultivator.formasi.spec.red_sand.name: Red Sand Formation
kultivator.formasi.spec.red_sand.desc: An intruder crossing the edge inward falls into the pit: rooted 4 s (elites 2 s, bosses 1 s), once per 15 s. Inside, blade sand cuts for 1.5 × P every second, and every 2 s Blindness for 2 s (never on bosses).
kultivator.formasi.spec.red_sand.hint: Chiseled red sandstone under the eye; cut red sandstone at 2 and 4 out on both axes (the three qi); corner pillars at 6 of red sandstone ×2 topped with chiseled red sandstone. No red sand is needed.
kultivator.formasi.spec.red_sand.source: Investiture of the Gods ch. 44: Zhang Tianjun's Red Sand Formation divides three qi with three dou of red sand inside; when wind and thunder move, the flying sand wounds. Ch. 49: King Wu and his horse fall into the pit, the sand cuts like blades, and talismans front and back protect his body.
kultivator.formasi.spec.great_geng_sword: Every second up to 6 intruders inside take a phantom sword strike for 4 × P. Every 5 s the Seventy-Two Swords sweep the densest cluster for 8 × P to up to 8 mobs. Damage only through the formation damage type, within the kill caps.
Iron block (Geng metal) under the eye and an end rod on it (the master sword); eight posts of bamboo block ×3 with an end rod on top, 7 out on the cardinals and 5 out on the diagonals.

RMJ ch. 788, 789, 1237 and 1386: Han Li's Great Geng Sword Formation ("Aureate Sword Formation"), 36 then 72 Bamboo Cloudswarm Swords with threads of sword qi spreading over 1,000 feet. RMJ ch. 1535: 72 sword projections fly into the bamboo and 72 azure swords remain. RMJ ch. 412: Gold Lightning Bamboo.
Every 1.5 s three bolts of light from a dark cloud disc hit three different intruders for 6 × P plus Slowness II for 1 s; a mob killed by a bolt bursts into ash. Particles only: never a real lightning bolt, never weather.

Faces true north. Chiseled copper under the eye; three banner pillars of cut copper ×4 with a banner on top: Heaven 6 north, Earth at 5 west 3 south, Man at 5 east 3 south; chiseled copper thunder stones opposite each banner. Copper may weather or be waxed.
Investiture of the Gods ch. 44: Qin Tianjun's Heaven Absolute Formation has three banners after Heaven, Earth and Man, merged into one qi; whoever enters is turned to dust where the thunder sounds.
kultivator.formasi.spec.earth_fierce.des: Every second up to 10 intruders inside catch fire for 3 s and take 2 × P (fire-immune mobs take the damage only). Every 3 s thunder above deals 5 × P to up to 10 intruders.
kultivator.formasi.spec.earth_fierce.hin: Red nether bricks under the eye and a red banner on it; magma vents 6 out on the cardinals and 4 out on the diagonals; thunder posts on the corners at 6 of cut copper ×3 topped with an end rod.
kultivator.formasi.spec.earth_fierce.sou: Investiture of the Gods ch. 44: Zhao Tianjun's Earth Fierce Formation hides one red banner inside; when it is waved, thunder roars above and fire rises below. It is broken in ch. 45.
kultivator.formasi.spec.blazing_flame.de: Three fires every second on up to 14 intruders: samadhi fire (6 s of burning; fire-immune mobs take 2 × P instead), fire in the air (2.5 × P each) and fire in stone (+4 × P near the magma station or on any magma inside).
kultivator.formasi.spec.blazing_flame.hi: A fire-body block under the eye; three red banner pillars (fire body ×4 + red banner) at 8 north and at 7 east/west 4 south; fire stations: soul campfire on polished blackstone (north-west), cinnabar walls ×2 with a shroomlight (north-east), magma 5 south.
kultivator.formasi.spec.blazing_flame.so: Investiture of the Gods ch. 44: Bai Tianjun's Blazing Flame Formation holds three fires, samadhi fire, fire in the air and fire in stone, with three red banners. Ch. 48: Lu Ya enters and faces fire in the air, fire below and samadhi fire.
kultivator.formasi.spec.red_water.name: Red Water Formation
kultivator.formasi.spec.red_water.desc: Every second red water hits up to 12 intruders: 3 × P plus 1% of max health (elites 0.5%, bosses 0.25%) and Slowness II for 2 s. Water mobs take ×1.5. The water blocks never change; the red is only particles.
kultivator.formasi.spec.red_water.hint: Sea lantern under the eye; a 3×3 smooth quartz platform with three water cauldrons on it (N, SE, SW); water sources 4 out on the cardinals and 3 out on the diagonals; corner pillars at 7: deep stone ×2, a fire-body block, a sea lantern.
kultivator.formasi.spec.red_water.source: Investiture of the Gods ch. 44: Wang Tianjun's Red Water Formation steals the Ren-Gui water essence, with an eight-trigram platform and three gourds that pour out red water turning flesh to blood water. Ch. 48: Cao Bao's limbs dissolve. It is broken in ch. 49.
kultivator.formasi.spec.sect_transfer.de: A transport node inside the territory. Sneak-use the eye with an empty hand to open the node map, then pick a destination: 3 s channel (1.5 s with a keeper), 10 qi from the traveller, 1 Daya from the source (none with a keeper). Up to 4 following disciples come along. Never across dimensions.
kultivator.formasi.spec.sect_transfer.hi: Crying obsidian under the eye; a 3×3 ring of end stone bricks, smooth quartz or calcite around it; four posts at the corners of purpur or quartz pillar ×2 with an end rod or lantern on top. Nodes must be 16 blocks apart.
kultivator.formasi.spec.sect_transfer.so: RMJ ch. 272 "One Year": an ancient transportation formation can be considered a formation spell, and Han Li hopes a formation master can help restore it. RMJ ch. 359: he buys the items needed in the Heavenly Star Sect's market city. RMJ ch. 363: he spends the following days restoring it.
kultivator.formasi.spec.ancient_transfer: The great node: links to every other ancient node and to every sect transfer node inside the territory, across any distance in the same dimension. 5 s channel, 30 s cooldown; the source pays 2 Daya per started 512 blocks (half with a Space keeper). The destination chunk is loaded briefly for the arrival, never kept loaded.
The sect transfer node plus four obelisks 4 out on the cardinals: chiseled quartz, quartz pillar ×2 and an end rod.

RMJ ch. 272, 359 and 363, as for the Sect Transfer Array. RMJ ch. 1130: an ancient teleportation formation on Stalwart Star Island that Han Li wants to find again. The range and the outposts are game design.
kultivator.formasi.spec.ten_thousand_imm: Complete when the pattern stands, the Grand Sect Formation is active and its three parts run in the same hall: Taiji (L1 or M2, or the Agung with 3+ layers), Liangyi (an Earth+ killing, maze or control array) and Sixiang (a Earth+ gathering, refining, tribulation or transport array, or M4). Then every other formation of the hall gets A +0.15 and radius +2, the stacking cap rises to 2.8, the Inner Layer of L1 needs no keeper and breakthroughs in the territory gain +0.04 quality.

Faces true north. A beacon on the eye (no pyramid needed); 8 smooth quartz around the eye; eight trigram pillars, 10 out on the cardinals and at (±7, ±7): chiseled quartz, three lines (yang = polished blackstone, yin = smooth quartz, bottom line first) and an end rod.

Investiture of the Gods ch. 82: one formation knotting three camps together, which Laozi names the array of Taiji, Liangyi and Sixiang; its gates and households are layered, and Tongtian Jiaozhu sits on the eight-trigram platform at its centre.
kultivator.formasi.spec.ten_absolute.des: The war altar. N (0-10) counts the built and running Absolute arrays (Heaven Absolute, Earth Fierce, Red Sand, Blazing Flame, Red Water) plus the five Absolute techniques known by the master or the altar's keeper. Active at N ≥ 3 with 2 built: every built Absolute gets A +0.03 × N and +2 targets. At N = 10 intruders lose Regeneration and Absorption and the Absolutes pulse faster.
kultivator.formasi.spec.ten_absolute.hin: Netherite block under the eye at the altar's head; ten poles of mangrove fence ×2 with a banner on top, 3 to each side, every 2 blocks from 2 to 10 away from the eye.
kultivator.formasi.spec.ten_absolute.sou: Investiture of the Gods ch. 44: the ten Heavenly Lords of Golden Turtle Island set up the Ten Absolute Formations for Grand Tutor Wen Zhong: Heaven Absolute, Earth Fierce, Wind Roaring, Cold Ice, Golden Light, Blood Transforming, Blazing Flame, Soul Falling, Red Water and Red Sand.
